Reopen it if the work is still relevant.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
`sgl-kernel/` -> `python/sglang/kernels/aot/`, `python/sglang/jit_kernel/`
-> `python/sglang/kernels/jit/`, `docs/` -> `docs/docs/` (`.mdx`),
`bench_serving.py` -> `benchmark/serving.py`, `test/srt/` -> `test/registered/`.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the NIXL bootstrap message handling logic by extracting it into a dedicated `_handle_bootstrap_message` method and wrapping its execution in a try-except block to gracefully handle exceptions. It also adds unit tests to verify the behavior under different message formats. The review feedback highlights a potential `IndexError` and `ValueError` when parsing malformed messages, as the current length check of 4 is insufficient for downstream parsing functions which require up to 7 or 12 frames. It suggests adding more robust validation for message length and encoding.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Checking only `len(waiting_req_bytes) < 4` is insufficient to prevent `IndexError` when parsing the message.

- If `room_str == "None"`, `KVArgsRegisterInfo.from_zmq` is called, which unconditionally accesses indices up to `msg[11]`, requiring at least 12 frames.
- If `room_str != "None"`, `TransferInfo.from_zmq` is called, which unconditionally accesses indices up to `msg[6]`, requiring at least 7 frames.

Additionally, if `room_str` is not a valid integer, `int(room_str)` will raise a `ValueError`.

We should validate these lengths and catch potential `ValueError`s to gracefully ignore malformed messages without raising exceptions or logging tracebacks.

```python
        waiting_req_bytes = waiting_req_bytes[1:]
        if len(waiting_req_bytes) < 4:
            logger.warning(
                "Ignoring malformed NIXL bootstrap message with %d frame(s) "
                "after guard",
                len(waiting_req_bytes),
            )
            return

        try:
            room_str = waiting_req_bytes[0].decode("ascii")
            agent_name = waiting_req_bytes[3].decode("ascii")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            logger.warning("Ignoring NIXL bootstrap message with non-ASCII metadata")
            return

        if room_str == "None":
            if len(waiting_req_bytes) < 12:
                logger.warning(
                    "Ignoring malformed NIXL bootstrap registration message with %d frame(s)",
                    len(waiting_req_bytes),
                )
                return
            # Register new peer and save KV base pointers.
            self._add_remote_peer(KVArgsRegisterInfo.from_zmq(waiting_req_bytes))
            logger.debug(f"Register KVArgs from {agent_name} successfully")
            return

        if len(waiting_req_bytes) < 7:
            logger.warning(
                "Ignoring malformed NIXL bootstrap transfer message with %d frame(s)",
                len(waiting_req_bytes),
            )
            return

        try:
            room = int(room_str)
        except ValueError:
            logger.warning(
                "Ignoring NIXL bootstrap message with invalid room ID %r",
                room_str,
            )
            return
```

+    def _handle_bootstrap_message(self, waiting_req_bytes: List[bytes]) -> None:
+        if not waiting_req_bytes:

+        if len(waiting_req_bytes) < 7:

+        if room not in self.transfer_infos:
+            self.transfer_infos[room] = {}
+        self.transfer_infos[room][agent_name] = TransferInfo.from_zmq(

+class TestNixlBootstrapMessages(CustomTestCase):
+    def _new_manager(self):
+        mgr = NixlKVManager.__new__(NixlKVManager)
+        mgr.enable_staging = False
+        mgr.transfer_infos = {}
+        mgr.req_to_decode_prefix_len = {}
+        mgr.update_status = MagicMock()
+        mgr._add_remote_peer = MagicMock()

+    def test_ignores_foreign_bootstrap_message(self):

+        mgr._handle_bootstrap_message([b"GET / HTTP/1.1"])

+        )

+        mgr.update_status.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_ignores_non_ascii_bootstrap_metadata(self):
+        mgr = self._new_manager()

+
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.transfer_infos, {})
+        mgr.update_status.assert_not_called()
+        mgr._add_remote_peer.assert_not_called()
